Picking wage: Dave's rule '4 hours of full-time picking pays about 40 to 60 copper' (0.17-0.25/min; docs/ECONOMY_FIRST_DAY.md:3-6), 0.2/min is the midpoint used by Sal (line 38). Hob: purse 300 then +100 per real hour (data/npcs/shops.json; server_trade.gd:397-414), so over the modeled 89 h at most 300 + 8,915 = 9,215 net (buying from Hob refills the purse: server_trade.gd:335, 517; the purse is shared by all players, so this is a single-player ceiling). Goal coin bypasses the purse (server_items.gd:15771-15772). Both ratios rest on the ASSUMED effort model (a lower bound): if real play takes 1.7x the modeled time or more, Hob's ceiling exceeds the draft total, though the picking-wage ratio stays above 8x until play takes 1.8x longer.
GA-70.correction: Recommended ~3059 copper (main route 1307) with class bands and a family-lead model (Q2).
